question: Which of the following dance forms is NOT associated with the state of Jharkhand?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Dhimsa__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dhimsa**

 
 
• Popular **Andhra Pradesh folk dances include the dhimsa dance.**
 
• In the Araku Valley, close to Visakhapatnam, it is common.
 
• The Porja tribe of Andhra Pradesh performs this folk dance.
 
• The** performance is shared by men and women.**
 
• The** Porja tribe primarily does it**.
 
• Porjas are mainly found in the** Andhra Pradeshi district of Vizag's tribal regions.**
 
• In the months of March and April, the** Dhimsa dance is performed.**** **
 
• It is typically performed at wedding celebrations, when the performers dress in elaborate** jewellery and dance to the rhythm of the drums. **
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__​**

 
• **Karma**

 
 
• **A traditional dance from central and eastern India** known as the "karma dance" or** "Karma Naach" **is performed each year at the "karma festival.
 
• " A well-known fall celebration called Karma begins on the** eleventh day **of the light fortnight in the **month of Bhadrab.**
 
 
 
• **Paika**
 
 
• In the** southern parts of Odisha,** a folk dance known as paika is very common.** **
 
• **Paika is a sort of long spear.**
 
• It has long been a part of Orissan culture and is currently a significant component of the state's well-known festivals.
 
• In the** Mayurbhanj area of Jharkhand, **members of the **Munda tribe perform the Paika dance.**
 
• Jhumar, Paika, **Jamda**, and other** Jharkhandi traditional dances are among the most well-liked.**
 
• In the state of Jharkhand, several folk dances are performed during** harvest time**,** festivals, and social events. **
